1244|245cbd71.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|245cbd71.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one. Although I have many names, I answer to few. But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken... for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.

1289|fe52f4ea.name: Gunther Weller
1289|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

2094|28b1f157.name: James Halloran
2094|28b1f157.text: Greetings, $c. I'm in a bit of a pinch right now, running very low on hides.

247264|a8fa316f.name: Emissary Jacques
247264|a8fa316f.text:
Hail and well met, traveler.

I wish my arrival was met with good tidings but the realm of Dalaran is in need of aid from the kingdoms of the Alliance.

2700|0efca734.name: Captain Nials
2700|0efca734.text:
We at Refuge Pointe hold one of the few remaining patches of Stromgarde territory in the Arathi Highlands.  And we're losing ground...

If you have words for me, then I hope they are good tidings.

2835|c5ceacbe.name: Cedrik Prose
2835|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

5482|52392408.name: Stephen Ryback
5482|52392408.text: Seek out Shandrina in Silverwind Refuge.  She can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".

5482|8cd6b7fd.name: Stephen Ryback
5482|8cd6b7fd.text: I don't get too many cooks in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

5483|877c4b1d.name: Erika Tate
5483|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

92432-accept.name: Emissary Jacques
92432-accept.text:
I bring ill tidings from Dalaran. Something has disrupted our ley lines, causing erratic and destructive behavior from our constructs in the city.

We know not yet what is causing this mayhem. The high council has ordered us to keep this matter private so as to not bring shame to our order. But we cannot keep up this charade forever. The city is being overrun as we speak!

Archmage Modera has dispatched me to solicit outside aid. Seek her image out near Dalaran beside Lordamere Lake.
92432-accept.title: An Alarming Request

95646-progress.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
95646-progress.text: These waters harbor unique life in a brine that gives and takes equally.
95646-progress.title: Horrors in the Highland

98072-progress.name: James Halloran
98072-progress.text: Ah, $N! Do you have those scales?
98072-progress.title: Crocs of the Sky

98283-progress.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
98283-progress.text:
The Rotclaw came down from their homes in Loch Modan, now driven mad.

Such a waste of life's boon.
98283-progress.title: Carnage

98291-complete.name: Howin Kindfeather
98291-complete.text: You won't catch me mournin' their ilk. They deserve their fate.
98291-complete.title: Death to the Dragonmaw

98293-complete.name: Captain Stoutfist
98293-complete.text:
Well done! Very well done!

We can definitely put these to use in replenishing our men. Half of these are from our own soldiers to begin with.

Fewer weapons in the hands of the enemy and more in ours is my kind of math, $c.
98293-complete.title: Forced Disarmament

98297-accept.name: Howin Kindfeather
98297-accept.text:
I did a quick test flight while ye were out. The good news is the armor ye helped me craft for Bassbeak works like a charm!

The very bad news is I saw a group o' them Dragonmaw in the process of enslavin' a red dragonspawn.

Absolutely not. Not again.

You have tae take it out. You'll certainly need friends tae do so. Kill the warlocks holding it down first--that ought tae free it. Then put it out of its misery.

None of them will stand in the way of the Wildhammer.
98297-accept.title: Stopping the Cycle

98297-complete.name: Howin Kindfeather
98297-complete.text:
I can't thank ye enough, $N. Truly, I cannae do enough for what ye've done today.

Much remains to be done before Grim Batol might hear the laughter of wee dwarven children echo through its halls again, but it's a mighty good step closer.

For all of the dwarves lost in those dark days, we may yet reclaim what was ours.

Here's hopin', anyway.
98297-complete.title: Stopping the Cycle

98300-accept.name: Howin Kindfeather
98300-accept.text:
My work here is far from over, $N. And I need tae send word to me wife Claira in Aerie Peak--and get Falstad an update as well.

But that's my business. Wildhammer business.

That said, you ought tae let King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge know about all this as well. Wetlands is but a stone's throw from his lands, and none of what's happenin' here is good news on one's doorstep. This letter oughta do the trick.

Ye can travel back through Dun Algaz or fly from Menethil Harbor to get to Ironforge.
98300-accept.title: Word to Ironforge

98300-complete.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
98300-complete.text:
Ah, the Wildhammer. Yes, I know them well. They may not call me sovereign, but our relations have improved greatly as of late--the Thandol Span is a testament to that.

If what this Howin reports is true, then we must prepare for further action on our northern borders. Grim Batol has a deep, bloody history, and I'm well aware of its strategic significance.

For your efforts in helping the Wildhammer in the Wetlands, and the Alliance in Menethil Harbor as well, you have my thanks.
98300-complete.title: Word to Ironforge

98300-progress.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
98300-progress.text: Welcome to Ironforge, $c. I am King Magni Bronzebeard, ruler of these lands.
98300-progress.title: Word to Ironforge

98815-progress.name: James Halloran
98815-progress.text: Welcome back, $c. Need any leather oil for your equipment?
98815-progress.title: Highland Hides
